topic: Your phone has more computing power than NASA used to reach the Moon
hook: Your phone is more powerful than the computer that reached the Moon.
script: Your phone is more powerful than the computer that reached the Moon. The Apollo 11 guidance computer had 64 kilobytes of memory. Your phone has 256 gigabytes. That's 4 million times more storage. NASA landed humans on the Moon with less computing power than a modern calculator. We use that power to scroll social media. Follow for facts that put technology into humbling perspective.
